name: plumbline
description: Proportional, evidence-driven engineering workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Aligned engineering workflows for agentic development
interface.longDescription: Plumbline helps Codex move from product intent to implementation, verification, acceptance, and current repository documentation with only the process the work needs. Plugin installation is inert; the front door detects an uninitialized repository and presents the explicit setup proposal before any repository writes. Optional trusted hooks restore explicitly activated continuity and can wake an explicitly selected Checkpoint Relay without selecting phases or dispatching work themselves.
defaultPrompt: Use Plumbline to shape this feature before implementation.

Use Plumbline to review these changes for behavior and completeness.
